title: Amethyst Addon
description: Amethyst Addon is a mod that adds weapons and tool that can be crafted using amethyst.
body:
Amethyst Addon is a mod that gives a purpose why you should collect amethyst. In comparasion with normal tools, the Amethyst tools are made to not be op but are made to be fair. The Amethyst tools are like diamond tools but have less durability. The mod adds amethyst weapons for your survival or hardcore worlds so then you have more fun! You should download it so you can start having more fun!

Includes:

Amethyst Sword
Amethyst Pickaxe
Amethyst Axe
Amethyst Shovel
Amethyst Hoe
5 Crafting Recipes
2 Advancement
